neighbours.label: the politic- word family (political, politics, politicized), not policy or government
fire: The scandal quickly turned into a political crisis for the mayor.

At family dinners she avoids discussing politics.
The party hired a political consultant before the campaign.
Some fear the courts are becoming politicised in this country.
In that office, politics made the job more stressful than expected.

Some fear the courts are becoming overloaded in this country.

predictions: Fires on political/politics/politicized; quiet on financial, economics, policy and other neighbouring words in the same slot.
